input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，A location phrase such as “在墓地里” normally comes before the main verb “玩.”
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：假装祭拜，“假装” is the verb used before another action to mean pretending to do it; “装” does not fit directly before “祭拜” here.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟妈妈：妈妈带着孟子，“跟孟子搬家” is not the appropriate wording for a mother moving together with her child; use “带着孟子搬家” to show that the mother takes Mengzi with her.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩：有一个小男孩叫孟子。他小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩，On first mention, introduce the character with a name and a brief noun phrase; after that, use a pronoun when the referent is clear.
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友：他和朋友，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence: Mengzi was the subject of the preceding sentence, so repeating his name is unnecessary.
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子五岁的时候：他五岁的时候，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence because Mengzi remains the clear topic from the previous sentence.
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬家：搬家了，Use “了” for a completed action: this move happened before the following explanation of why the family moved.

items.reason: 地点短语“在墓地里”应放在动词“玩”前面。
“装”不能直接这样搭配“祭拜”，而“假装祭拜”是正确的说法。
“孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家”自然地表示孟子和妈妈一起搬家，并没有错误。
首次出现角色时，按老师的标准应先用简短的名词短语介绍孟子。
孟子在紧邻的前一句已经出现，再次作主语时应使用“他”。
孟子仍是紧接上文的明确话题，因此这里应说“他五岁的时候”。
这里叙述的是已经发生并完成的搬家事件，应使用“搬家了”。
